nature: Post-CVH03 static benchmark suitability and prospective (unconsumed) future-science design; not itself science evaluation.

candidate_primary.sequence: Collect yellow key, unlock/activate yellow door, traverse to goal; key and door do not reward, reward on goal only; true delayed prerequisite with partial view.
candidate_primary.allowed_public_input: Only env.reset/step public observation: (7x7x3 uint8 tile observation, direction 0..3), public observed reward and done flags; mission is a constant natural-language instruction and MUST be excluded from every arm for tokenless evaluation.
candidate_primary.action_space: Seven discrete actions 0..6, 0=left,1=right,2=forward,3=pickup,4=drop,5=toggle,6=done. No binary proxy or remapped environment unless separately preregistered and equal for controls.
candidate_primary.reward: Only goal entry yields 1 - 0.9*step_count/max_steps; otherwise zero. For 8x8 default max_steps=640. Terminated on goal, truncated when step_count>=max_steps.
candidate_primary.source_usage: Read original GitHub files and legal metadata by Git blob; do not construct/reset/step original environment or inspect seed-specific maps. No privileged internal grid state passed to a learner.

risk.licensing: SOURCE LICENSE METADATA INCONSISTENCY: repository LICENSE is Apache-2.0 text, pyproject states MIT; legal/owner documentation must be resolved before vendoring/redistribution.
risk.platform: Official README reports Linux/macOS supported; Windows not officially supported. Windows must be tested rather than assumed.
risk.dependency: Python>=3.11, numpy>=1.18.0, gymnasium>=0.28.1, pygame-ce>=2.4.0 are declared; freeze concrete transitive lock and no display/render dependency in headless run.
risk.compatibility: CVH02 accepts 0/1 current state/actions and 36 slots. DoorKey has 7 actions and 7x7x3 observations: CVH02 is INVALID as-is. New tokenless typed observation/action adapter and multistep model must be independently developed/tested without editing qualified CVH02.

secondary_control.role: Supplementary two-action deep-exploration and scalable retention challenge; NOT substitute for DoorKey's true prerequisite chain.
secondary_control.caveat: A local action's right-move may be inferable from immediate state transition or move-cost signal; avoid claiming a unique planning advantage solely from delayed terminal reward.

protocol_seeds.experimental_usage: NONE YET; held seed assignments are proposed prospective and unavailable to learners before owner approval.

task_progression: DoorKey 16x16 optional separately qualified harder transfer; not pooled into primary
frozen_future_science_contract.candidate: Novel tokenless persistent causal action-consequence/successor-value learner, no raw mission text, maintained numerical observation/event encoding and cold-store; source blind.
frozen_future_science_contract.same_information_actions_budget: All candidate and conventional learners receive identical public image+direction, action set, episode budget, allocated transitions/training compute/eval maps; never private grid coordinates/key/door placement.
strong_controls: Fully trained recurrent PPO/LSTM or recurrent Q learner with matched observed public inputs and transition budget
Independent optimized symbolic/graph belief-state controller built only from the same public observation history
Numerical return-to-go batch estimator and immediate-reward-only ablation
Oracle planner with full original map only as NONCOMPARABLE ceiling, never strong-control equity baseline
Random and scripted demonstration-only sanity controls
frozen_future_science_contract.blinding: Source owner generates and scores held maps with pre-frozen source SHA and seeds, no policy tuning on held; store action tapes/source IDs and independent reevaluation.
frozen_future_science_contract.primary_metric: Held DoorKey 8x8 success proportion (goal reached), averaged across four independent model seeds ×64 held layouts, paired by maps.
secondary: Normalized discounted return and mean steps-to-goal
Steps/actions spent learning, training FLOPs/CPU/GPU/RAM/time, cold serialization and inference overhead
Cold retained previously earned sequences after training other maps; interference and unfamiliar transfer
Real action consequences, successful key acquisition/door unlock/goal chain, failure modes
frozen_future_science_contract.success_gate: Independently reproduced held success +0.10 absolute over strongest fully trained equal-information/compute control, paired map/bootstrap 95% lower bound >0, reproducible >=3/4 algorithm seeds, no material retention deficit. If controls tie or superior: SCIENTIFIC_NO_GO.
frozen_future_science_contract.stop_rule: No post-held retuning, source first-use or protected replay. If original public source can't be run cleanly with same semantics on required platforms, classify INFRA_UNVERIFIED, not scientific failure. If data/action/compute mismatch, fail closed.
frozen_future_science_contract.source_setup_constraints: Must qualify external dependency/Windows path, license clarity, exact source Git tree and self-contained native adapter first. A source-safe repository protocol is NOT execution approval.
